privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This notice explains what personal data TodoNow stores about you and why.

data.email: Your email address: to identify your account, let you log in and send you emails about your account, such as a password reset link.
data.displayName: Your display name: so the people in your family can see who shared or finished a task.
data.password: Your password: stored only in a non-readable form, to check it when you log in. Nobody, including us, can read it.
data.tasks: Your tasks and who you share them with: to show them to you and to the people you share them with.
data.family: Your family membership: so you can share tasks with the members of your family.
data.agreement: Your agreement to this notice: to record that you accepted it when you signed up.

protect.encrypted: All connections between your device and TodoNow are encrypted.
protect.access: You see only your own tasks and the tasks shared with you.
protect.deletion: When you delete your account, your personal data is removed.
protect.noSharing: We never share your personal data with anyone else and never sell it.

signup.title: Sign up
signup.passwordRule: At least 8 characters, with at least one lowercase letter (a-z), one uppercase letter (A-Z), one digit (0-9) and one keyboard symbol such as ! @ # $. Use only letters without marks, digits and keyboard symbols: letters with Vietnamese marks (such as ă, ê, ư) and spaces cannot be used.
signup.agreeLabel: I agree to the privacy notice
signup.errorAgreementRequired: Agreement to the privacy notice is required to create an account.
signup.errorPasswordRule: This password does not meet the password rule.
signup.errorInvalidInput: Please enter a valid email address and a display name.
signup.errorUnexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
